summary: Frontend-only validation for the CheerPlanner Share/Rate pop-ups. All primary flows work on the Expo web preview: Settings → Community → 'Share CheerPlanner' row (testID settings-share-app) is present and tapping it invokes shareApp() without crashing; the rate-prompt modal (rate-prompt-card) appears after saving a NEW payment (Ava Johnson $25) and also after checking off the last unchecked packing-list item on the upcoming Summit Championship competition; the modal exposes 'Rate CheerPlanner' (rate-prompt-rate) and 'Maybe later' (rate-prompt-later) buttons; the 2-week cooldown works (rate_prompt_last_shown_at is written immediately when shown, a second payment and a packing-complete both correctly did NOT re-show the modal while the key was present, and clearing the key reset the cooldown so the modal reappeared). No React Native red-screen errors observed. No deprecated packages surfaced in the touched files. Main-agent's concern about the payment athlete chip not toggling turned out to be a false alarm: chip DOES toggle when tapped (my earlier check via inner_html string match was wrong — Ava is auto-selected by the useEffect and the payment saved successfully with amount 25 and triggered the rate prompt).
action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: /app/frontend/src/components/PackingListSection.tsx `saveAsTemplate` uses `Alert.prompt?.(...) || (async () => {...})()` — on iOS Alert.prompt returns undefined so the Android fallback executes anyway, saving a template twice. Consider `Platform.OS === 'ios' ? Alert.prompt(...) : fallback()`. Not related to the pop-ups being tested.
critical_code_review_comments: RatePromptContext.tsx correctly writes the AsyncStorage timestamp BEFORE showing the modal (guarantees at-most-once per 14 days even if the user backgrounds the app), and guards with an inFlight ref + `visible` state to avoid double-open.
payments/new.tsx uses setTimeout(400) after router.back() to defer the prompt until after the screen dismisses — verified working on web preview.
competitions/[id].tsx correctly gates the packing-complete prompt with `daysBetween(comp.event_date) !== null && >= 0` so past comps do not trigger it.
appShare.ts uses React Native Share API which is a no-op on web preview (as expected). Row tap fires without crash.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo@cheerplanner.app account with seeded Ava/Mia athletes and the upcoming Summit Championship competition. Created 3 small payments ($25, $20, $15) on Ava during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested at preview URL https://event-planner-394.preview.emergentagent.com using demo@cheerplanner.app / CheerDemo2026!. Rate cooldown storage key = localStorage 'rate_prompt_last_shown_at'; clear it to reset. Payment chip testIDs are `payment-athlete-<athleteId>`; the first athlete is auto-selected on mount so you do not need to toggle it to save. Rate-prompt testIDs: rate-prompt-card, rate-prompt-rate, rate-prompt-later. Packing item testIDs: packing-item-<id>. Native store review sheet (expo-store-review) is not testable on web — only the in-app 'Enjoying CheerPlanner?' pre-prompt modal is verifiable there.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no bug found for the requested features. All 3 scenarios (share row, payment→prompt, packing-complete→prompt) plus the 14-day cooldown behavior verified end-to-end on web preview.
